is_anopheles.evidence: The paper studies Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s.) in Côte d’Ivoire.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc N1575Y (N1570Y) and Vgsc L1014F (L995F).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides genotype counts (NN, NY, YY) for the N1575Y mutation for populations in Tiassalé and Elibou.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from natural breeding sites in Tiassalé and Elibou, Côte d’Ivoire.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical research article reporting original field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies locations as Tiassalé and Elibou, Côte d’Ivoire, and provides coordinates for both.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were carried out between April and November 2016.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections made in 2016.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in Table 1.

assessment.summary: This study reports the first detection of the N1575Y mutation in Anopheles gambiae s.l. in Côte d’Ivoire. Mosquitoes were collected from Tiassalé and Elibou in 2016 and tested for deltamethrin resistance and target-site mutations (L1014F and N1575Y).
